messages:
Maya Chen: quick heads-up — targeting Wed 2025-09-10 11:00am PT for public announce. need final changelog link, docs anchor, a 2-line bench blurb, and webinar CTA. who can take the eng handoff?
Alex Rivera: I can own changelog + docs publish. propose changelog freeze Tue 6pm PT, docs live by Tue 11:59pm PT.
Jordan Patel: fine for eng. will tag PRs and make sure release notes avoid internal codenames.
Samira Khan: marketing needs: 1) bench one-liner + 2 callouts; 2) blog hero and subhead; 3) tweet copy; 4) signup modal with UTM and lead-tier routing. Samira will draft.
Linh Tran: tagging deploy-bot to schedule rolling window. deploy-bot: pls queue canary starting at announce time with 90m watch.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary 2025-09-10T11:00:00-07:00, watch 90m, notify #eng-oncall #eng-sre.
Maya Chen: inbound routing rule: route signups to SDR-Enterprise if company_size>50 OR email domain not personal (no gmail/yahoo). need hidden field computed client-side as `lead_tier`.
Samira Khan: will implement hidden `lead_tier` and pass lead metadata to HubSpot. sample fields we need: account_id, inferred_region, plan_hint. Alex — can eng provide names?
Alex Rivera: yes. we expose account_id and region via the metadata endpoint. field names: `account_id`, `inferred_region`, `plan_hint`.
Jordan Patel: bench context: tests run on g5.12x, seq_len=1024, batch=32, warm cache. p50 down 12.1%, p99 down 19.8%, token cost down 24.7% with prefix caching + quant profile alpha. callout: small single-token requests see minimal change.
Samira Khan: good — marketing will round: "p99 latency improved ~20%, token cost reduced ~25%". include test hardware & config in the notes.
Maya Chen: webinar CTA copy idea: "Join our 9/12 deep-dive: live demo + benchmarks" link: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=announce&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=release1766. Add hidden param `lead_tier` and `account_id`.
Samira Khan: drafting tweet options now: 1) "Faster, cheaper inference — rolling out now. Join our webinar 9/12: [link]" 2) "Reduce p99 latency by ~20% and token cost by ~25% — deep dive 9/12". will post in doc.
Alex Rivera: quick note on rollout: Canary 0%->5% at 11:00, 30% at +45m, 100% at +120m if metrics OK. fallback config: `fallback_policy: revert_on_error_rate(1.3x)` and `monitor.metrics: p99, error_rate, qps`.
Jordan Patel: I'll add canary playbook to eng-releases and share link to marketing: https://redwood.ai/internal/eng-releases/canary-1766.md
Maya Chen: embargo? we need an embargoed beta email to existing customers Tue 8am PT. press embargo until Wed 11:00 PT. Samira: can you include an embargo note in the doc?
Samira Khan: yes — will mark assets as EMBARGOED and create separate folder for press. also adding a one-paragraph executive summary for the press kit.
Linh Tran: small ops ask: if errors spike >1.4x baseline in the watch window auto-swap to previous model version. config snippet in playbook `if error_rate > 1.4 * baseline -> auto_swap(previous_version)`.
Maya Chen: final checklist: Alex drop final docs link here when live; Jordan share playbook link; Samira post blog + social drafts by Tue noon PT for review.
Alex Rivera: will publish docs at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1766#changelog by Tue 23:50 PT and paste link here.
Jordan Patel: canary playbook link posted to shared doc: https://redwood.ai/internal/eng-releases/canary-1766.md (shared with #marketing).
Samira Khan: ack. aiming to post drafts Tue 12:00 PT, will include bench visuals and the JSON embed sample. sample embed: ```{
  "release": "v1766",
  "p99_reduction": "19.8%",
  "token_cost_reduction": "24.7%"
}```
Maya Chen: thanks team. looping back Tue morning for a final pulse. :rocket:
